title: Refactor python_paginated_api to use dataclasses.asdict
description: Brownfield Python/FastAPI refactor: replace manual dict construction with dataclasses.asdict for cleaner serialization.

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor src/app.py to eliminate manual dict-building. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

In list_products():
  — replace {"id": p.id, "name": p.name, "category": p.category, "price": p.price}
    with dataclasses.asdict(p)
  — import dataclasses at the top of the file

In get_product(product_id):
  — replace the manual dict with dataclasses.asdict(p) before returning

Do not change any route paths, function signatures, or behavior.
All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: list_products uses dataclasses.asdict instead of manual dict
get_product uses dataclasses.asdict instead of manual dict
API behavior is identical to before
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
